---
title: "In-silico suppression of MAG-associated biofilm transcription"
format: html
editor: source
---

Author-authorised what-if model. Suppress each candidate MAG's combined-list
RNA contribution by0-95%, holding other genes, effective library sizes, covariates
and fitted coefficients fixed. No new p-value filtering or refitting. This is an
effective transcriptional suppression axis, NOT phage dose, mortality or inferred
infection susceptibility. No compensatory community growth or matrix turnover.
Recompute the original score with the same edgeR prior.count0.5 and frozen gene
centres; never multiply a centred/log score by(1-s). Phenotype response ratio is
10^(beta*delta_score), a conditional geometric-scale projection. Digitised outcomes
describe released cells/EPS, not residual membrane biomass. 100% omitted to avoid
presenting a pseudocount-determined floor as a biological extinction prediction.

Reference precedent: Martínez Arbas,Narayanasamy etal,Nat Microbiol,
doi10.1038/s41564-020-00794-8, Methods Linear model of community dynamics,
removed predictor groups to assess importance. This graded fixed-coefficient
perturbation is different from their model refitting/variable-ablation analysis.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(edgeR);library(ggplot2)})
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
r<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
src<-c(members=file.path(r,"mag_functional_concentration_combined_2026-09-13-v1/tables/membership_and_original_statistics.tsv.gz"),
 counts=file.path(r,"full_transcriptome_de/tables/collapsed_raw_count_matrix.tsv"),
 libs=file.path(r,"full_transcriptome_de/tables/library_sizes_and_normalization.tsv"),
 models=file.path(r,"biofilm_phenotype_associations_2026-09-14-v1/tables/model_results.tsv"),
 observations=file.path(r,"biofilm_phenotype_associations_2026-09-14-v1/tables/model_observations.tsv"),
 deletion=file.path(r,"biofilm_phenotype_associations_2026-09-14-v1/tables/deletion_sensitivity.tsv"))
sha<-function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
hashes<-vapply(src,sha,character(1))
m<-fread(src['members'])[set_id=="biofilm_combined"]
libs<-fread(src['libs']);samples<-libs$sample_title
counts<-fread(src['counts'],select=c("feature_id",samples))
counts<-counts[match(m$feature_id,feature_id)];stopifnot(identical(counts$feature_id,m$feature_id),nrow(m)==3905)
mat<-as.matrix(counts[,..samples]);lcpm<-cpm(mat,lib.size=libs$effective_library_size,log=TRUE,prior.count=.5)
centres<-rowMeans(lcpm);models<-fread(src['models']);obs<-fread(src['observations']);del<-fread(src['deletion'])
candidates<-unique(models$MAG_ID);stopifnot(length(candidates)==14)
levels_s<-c(0,seq(.1,.9,.1),.95)
rows<-list();pool<-list()
for(mag in candidates){
 ix<-which(m$MAG_ID==mag)
 baseline<-colMeans(lcpm[ix,,drop=FALSE]-centres[ix])
 score_obs<-unique(obs[MAG_ID==mag,.(sample_title,expression_score)])
 stopifnot(max(abs(baseline-score_obs$expression_score[match(samples,score_obs$sample_title)]))<1e-9)
 for(s in levels_s){
  newlog<-cpm(mat[ix,,drop=FALSE]*(1-s),lib.size=libs$effective_library_size,log=TRUE,prior.count=.5)
  newscore<-colMeans(newlog-centres[ix]);delta<-newscore-baseline
  stopifnot(all(delta<=1e-10),if(s==0)max(abs(delta))<1e-10 else TRUE)
  base<-data.table(MAG_ID=mag,suppression=s,sample_title=samples,
   baseline_score=baseline,suppressed_score=newscore,delta_score=delta,
   transcript_pool_loss_pct=100*s*colSums(mat[ix,,drop=FALSE])/colSums(mat),
   outside_observed_score_range=newscore<min(baseline)|newscore>max(baseline))
  base<-merge(base,libs[,.(sample_title,condition,phase,cycle)],by="sample_title")
  pool[[paste(mag,s)]]<-base
  for(o in unique(models$outcome)){
   fit<-models[MAG_ID==mag & outcome==o];d<-copy(base)
   crit<-qt(.975,fit$df);hc<-fit$beta+c(-1,1)*crit*fit$HC3_se
   dd<-del[MAG_ID==mag & outcome==o,beta]
   d[,`:=`(outcome=o,genus=fit$genus,beta=fit$beta,
    change_pct=100*(10^(fit$beta*delta_score)-1),
    nominal_low=100*(10^(fit$CI_high*delta_score)-1),
    nominal_high=100*(10^(fit$CI_low*delta_score)-1),
    HC3_low=100*(10^(max(hc)*delta_score)-1),
    HC3_high=100*(10^(min(hc)*delta_score)-1),
    pixel_low=100*(10^(fit$pixel_beta_high*delta_score)-1),
    pixel_high=100*(10^(fit$pixel_beta_low*delta_score)-1),
    deletion_low=100*(10^(max(dd)*delta_score)-1),
    deletion_high=100*(10^(min(dd)*delta_score)-1))]
   rows[[paste(mag,s,o)]]<-d
  }
 }
}
d<-rbindlist(rows);p<-rbindlist(pool)
stopifnot(nrow(d)==14*11*12*3,all(d[suppression==0,change_pct]==0),
 all(d$nominal_low<=d$change_pct+1e-8),all(d$nominal_high>=d$change_pct-1e-8))
# Combined14-target transcript-pool accounting ONLY; single-MAG phenotype models
# cannot be summed into a joint intervention prediction.
combined<-rbindlist(lapply(levels_s,function(s)data.table(suppression=s,sample_title=samples,
 combined_pool_loss_pct=100*s*colSums(mat[m$MAG_ID %in% candidates,,drop=FALSE])/colSums(mat))))
combined<-merge(combined,libs[,.(sample_title,condition,phase,cycle)],by="sample_title")
for(x in c("tables","figures","source"))dir.create(file.path(out,x),recursive=TRUE)
fwrite(d,file.path(out,"tables/phenotype_scenarios.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(p,file.path(out,"tables/single_MAG_transcript_pool_scenarios.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(combined,file.path(out,"tables/combined14_transcript_pool_only.tsv"),sep="\t")
summary<-d[condition=="treatment",.(change_pct=mean(change_pct),nominal_low=mean(nominal_low),
 nominal_high=mean(nominal_high),HC3_low=mean(HC3_low),HC3_high=mean(HC3_high),
 outside_range_samples=sum(outside_observed_score_range)),by=.(MAG_ID,genus,outcome,suppression)]
fwrite(summary,file.path(out,"tables/treatment_summary.tsv"),sep="\t")
summary[,label:=paste(ifelse(is.na(genus)|genus=="","Unclassified",genus),sub("_MAGScoT_cleanbin_"," / ",MAG_ID))]
# Show all candidates at50% suppression; full curves/tables retained.
g<-ggplot(summary[abs(suppression-.5)<1e-8],aes(change_pct,label))+
 geom_vline(xintercept=0,colour="grey60")+geom_segment(aes(x=nominal_low,xend=nominal_high,yend=label),colour="grey65")+
 geom_point(size=2,colour="#176B83")+facet_wrap(~outcome,nrow=1,scales="free_x")+
 theme_bw(base_size=9)+labs(x="Projected change in released material (%)",y=NULL,
  subtitle="50% suppression of each MAG's biofilm-associated RNA contribution; treatment samples averaged",
  caption="Dots: fixed-coefficient scenarios. Lines: nominal coefficient intervals, not intervention prediction intervals. No phage dose implied.")
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/suppression50_all_MAGs.png"),g,width=15,height=8,dpi=160,device=ragg::agg_png)
stopifnot(identical(hashes,vapply(src,sha,character(1))))
file.copy(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"),file.path(out,"source/biofilm_MAG_suppression.qmd"))
fwrite(data.table(input=names(src),path=src,sha256=hashes),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=file.path(out,"sessionInfo.txt"))
writeLines(c("PASS: baseline scores reproduced; zero suppression gives zero change;monotone score suppression;interval ordering;input hashes unchanged.",
 "No 100% extrapolation. Outside-score-range samples explicitly flagged.",
 "Nominal,HC3,pixel and deletion envelopes retained separately, not a joint uncertainty distribution.",
 "Projected response is released cells/EPS, not attached biofilm or validated phage response.",
 "Other community contributions fixed; no ecological compensation model."),file.path(out,"CHECKS.txt"))
files<-list.files(out,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(out)+2),sha256=vapply(files,sha,character(1))),file.path(out,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
```
